searchText: Miners mine an empty block while processing the previous block and while preparing the next block. If a block is found during that window, it will be empty. <@!187490121698770945> do you have any dates to propose for next stateless call? Can you check in with <@!461762841641484302> or <@!688889240125308981> to see if we can find a time that allows them to join and still doesn't end up excluding others? (we are in Brisbane, time zone AEST)
